summary: Publish the SOP v1 foundation, new-ticket procedure, and safe local sync runtime

delivery.outcome: A publishable SOP v1 foundation slice: schema and catalog, canonical new-ticket procedure, safe local synchronization runtime, architecture, and Dual-LLM methodology.
nonGoals: Implement unconstrained autonomous commit execution without human supervision
Publish the repair, validator-dispatch, or cross-sync procedures in this foundation slice
Bypass validator-agent quality gates or merge direct to main without checks

architecture.decision: Publish a bounded SOP foundation with the new-ticket contract, deterministic local conformance runtime, and evaluation methodology; defer the remaining procedures.
interfaceChanges: Introduce schemas/sop.schema.json as the wellmanifest.sop/v1 contract
Introduce spec/sop-procedures.yaml and spec/sop-new-ticket.yaml as the foundation catalog and canonical procedure
Introduce the local scan, diff, patch, sync, verify, and validate-spec interface
dataChanges: Define audit receipts and drift metrics for repositories
architecture.rollback: Discard unmerged ticket branch and revert to baseline.
